# Expected output for simple.pegz parser
# This file describes what the generated parser should be able to do

## Test Cases

### Test 1: Hello rule
Input: "hello, world"
Expected: Match success

### Test 2: Greeting rule - choice
Input: "Hello"
Expected: Match success (first alternative)

Input: "Hi"
Expected: Match success (second alternative)

Input: "Hey"
Expected: Match success (third alternative)

Input: "Greetings"
Expected: Match failure (no alternative matches)

### Test 3: Sentence rule - sequence
Input: "Ieatfood"
Expected: Match success

Input: "Theysleepwell"
Expected: Match success

Input: "Eat"
Expected: Match failure (no Subject)

### Test 4: Numbers rule - repetition
Input: "12345"
Expected: Match success (one or more numbers)

Input: "0"
Expected: Match success (single number)

Input: ""
Expected: Match failure (empty, need at least one)

### Test 5: Maybe rule - optional
Input: "yes"
Expected: Match success

Input: ""
Expected: Match success (optional matches empty)

### Test 6: Start rule - and predicate
Input: "abc"
Expected: Match success (starts with 'a')

Input: "xyz"
Expected: Match failure (doesn't start with 'a')

### Test 7: NotQuote rule - not predicate
Input: "hello"
Expected: Match success (no quote character)

Input: "\"quoted\""
Expected: Match failure (contains quote)

### Test 8: AnyChar rule
Input: "x"
Expected: Match success (any single character)

Input: ""
Expected: Match failure (empty input)
